translation.title: Felbinac Adhesive Patch
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: For the S type, peel off the release liner and apply 1 patch to the affected area twice a day. For the R type, cut it to a suitable length, peel off the release liner and apply it to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or if you are hypersensitive to aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (asthma, hives, or acute rhinitis). Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, or if the user is a child. Do not use it on damaged skin or mucous membranes, or on areas with eczema or rash. Itching, redness, flushing, dermatitis (rash, eczema), or contact dermatitis may occur occasionally, and irritation or blisters rarely. If any of these occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature.
